title: Haitian traditions of beings among us

tellings.quote: somebody just emailed me and told me about Traditions like that in Haiti you know and that you know he came to the United States and he could believe that we didn't have any belief in this at all when he would see things like that when he was there

plain: In Haiti there are said to be old traditions of strange beings living among people, and of people seeing them. The religion scholar Diana Pasulka says a man emailed her about this. He told her that when he came to the United States he could hardly believe that people here had no belief in such things, given what he had seen back in Haiti.
